review_notes: Codex reviewed the annual assembly rule and its timing exception. The standalone excerpt repeats the amendment heading for source attribution. Congress must meet at least annually; the January date applies unless Congress sets another day by law. These are Codex labels, not independent human labels.
text:
AMENDMENT XX
Section 2.

The Congress shall assemble at least once in every year, and such meeting shall begin at noon on the 3d day of January, unless they shall by law appoint a different day.
